rootCauseAnalysis.triggerPattern: Literal HTML string <form action="https://formspree.io/f/x" method="post"><input name="email"...> combined with third-party form handler formspree.io URL strings
rootCauseAnalysis.mechanism: Microsoft Defender Archive Scanner parses deflated JS files inside ZIP containers. The combination of formspree.io with email input and hidden submit triggers the machine-learning (HNFS!MTB) phishing template detector.

remediationPlan.action: Sanitize test fixture domain in test/run_submit_nomessage_semiauto_regression.js to RFC 2606 synthetic domain (https://form-service.example.test), package new clean REV21 kit, verify with Defender scanner, preserve REV20 as immutable forensic evidence.
remediationPlan.ownerSafetyNotice: Owner MUST NOT disable Defender, whitelist files, bypass Safe Browsing, or install quarantined REV20.
